sections.title: Cartoon time — A poster for Earth Day

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Bobby, Sam and their friends are doing a project for Earth Day.
lines.chinese: Bobby、Sam和他们的朋友正在做一个地球日项目。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: The Earth is our home. What can we do to help it?
lines.chinese: 地球是我们的家。我们能做些什么来帮助它呢？

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: Let's make a poster about it. Will you join me?
lines.chinese: 我们为此做一张海报吧。你们愿意和我一起做吗？

lines.speaker: Others
lines.english: OK!
lines.chinese: 好的！

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Will you draw or write on the poster, Sam?
lines.chinese: Sam，你会在海报上画画还是写字？

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: I'll draw the Earth and colour it green and blue.
lines.chinese: 我会画地球，把它涂成绿色和蓝色。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Now it's my turn! I'll draw some banana trees. I like bananas.
lines.chinese: 现在轮到我了！我会画一些香蕉树。我喜欢香蕉。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: What will you draw, Billy?
lines.chinese: Billy，你会画什么？

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.english: I'll draw a rubbish bin.
lines.chinese: 我会画一个垃圾桶。

lines.speaker: Willy
lines.english: Why will you draw a rubbish bin, Billy?
lines.chinese: Billy，你为什么要画垃圾桶？

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.english: It's for Bobby's banana skins!
lines.chinese: 这是用来放Bobby的香蕉皮的！

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.english: Now it's your turn, Willy.
lines.chinese: Willy，现在轮到你了。

lines.speaker: Willy
lines.english: Thanks. I'll write something on the poster.
lines.chinese: 谢谢。我会在海报上写些内容。

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.english: What about "Help the Earth, Help Us"?
lines.chinese: 写“帮助地球，帮助我们自己”怎么样？

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: We're all born on the Earth.
lines.chinese: 我们都出生在地球上。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: It's important to everyone,
lines.chinese: 地球对每个人都很重要，

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Short or tall, old or young.
lines.chinese: 无论个子高矮，无论年老年少。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Love Mother Earth.
lines.chinese: 热爱地球母亲。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Never let her down.
lines.chinese: 永远不要让她失望。

sections.title: Story time — Take care of the Earth

lines.speaker: Miss Li
lines.english: Every year, people in many countries turn off their lights for an hour. Do you know this activity?
lines.chinese: 每年，许多国家的人们都会关灯一小时。你们知道这项活动吗？

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: Yes, it's Earth Hour. It tells people to save electricity.
lines.chinese: 知道，是地球一小时。它提醒人们节约用电。

lines.speaker: Miss Li
lines.english: That's right. Earth Hour is on the last Saturday of March. It lasts from 8:30 to 9:30 in the evening. Will you take part?
lines.chinese: 没错。地球一小时在三月的最后一个星期六，从晚上8点半持续到9点半。你们会参加吗？

lines.speaker: Yang Ling
lines.english: Yes, I will. It'll be great to help the Earth.
lines.chinese: 是的，我会。能帮助地球真是太好了。

lines.speaker: Other students
lines.english: Me too!
lines.chinese: 我也是！

lines.speaker: Miss Li
lines.english: What else will you do to take care of the Earth?
lines.chinese: 你们还会做些什么来爱护地球？

lines.speaker: Su Hai
lines.english: I'll save water. We should turn off the tap when we brush our teeth.
lines.chinese: 我会节约用水。刷牙时，我们应该关掉水龙头。

lines.speaker: Liu Tao
lines.english: I won't waste food. We should always eat up all our food.
lines.chinese: 我不会浪费食物。我们应该总是把自己的食物吃完。

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.english: I'll save paper. We should use both sides of the paper.
lines.chinese: 我会节约用纸。我们应该使用纸的两面。

lines.speaker: Miss Li
lines.english: Wonderful! These small things will help our Mother Earth in a big way. Let's work together!
lines.chinese: 太棒了！这些小事会大大帮助我们的地球母亲。让我们一起努力吧！
